topic.title: Specialized and Unknown DITA Elements
topic.shortdesc: Demonstrates lossless passthrough for specialized DITA 1.3 tags, custom elements, comments, processing instructions, and verbatim whitespace.

body.p:
This topic mixes base DITA inline elements with domain elements and vendor-specific markup: DITAEditor, the glossary key , a custom inline tag 1.6, and a footnote
Footnote text with inline code and a cross reference..

body.p: Verbatim whitespace inside screen is preserved exactly as typed, including line breaks and indentation:
body.screen: $ dita --input=product-manual.ditamap --format=html5 --transtype=html5 [INFO] Processing completed in 4.2s [INFO] Output: out/index.html

section.title: Unknown block passthrough
section.p: Any element the schema does not model is kept as an opaque block with its tag name, namespace, and original attribute order. Authoring inside it is disabled, but its text and attributes survive every save:

sectiondiv.p: This sectiondiv is modeled only as a generic block. Editing its inner paragraph still produces a minimal one-line diff.

section.note: Do not "clean up" specialized markup in the source editor. If a specialized element rejects a child, the structure panel reports the mismatch instead of silently rewriting the XML.
